coreFinding.reason: A distinct use-date is not by itself a provenance-complete, decision-time-admissible prospective market observation. Retain the PF056 source-generation observation but do not count it as an OOS/PIT-ready decision sample.
coreFinding.interpretation: The prior 30/30 statement may reflect earlier execution; this receipt alone does not independently demonstrate it. This audit does not claim earlier tests failed.

hypotheses.claim: Published ETF use-date creates an admissible prediction sample
hypotheses.support: Issuer use-date and posted time identify a plausible operational generation
hypotheses.counter: Raw bytes, full basket, verified first-known clock and conflict-free vintage are absent
hypotheses.alternative: A date-specific descriptive receipt can exist without being PIT-admissible
hypotheses.failure: Any unresolved source revision, incomplete basket or decision-time clock

hypotheses.claim: Unit delta measures executed constituent flow
hypotheses.support: Primary-market issuance may create a delivery requirement
hypotheses.counter: AP inventory, cash substitution, cash creation, futures and timing obscure actual trades
hypotheses.alternative: Modeled basket notional is only a scenario

hypotheses.claim: ETF creation and borrow/foreign flow are independent bullish confirmations
hypotheses.counter: One creation event can cause multiple observed legs
hypotheses.failure: No common-root provenance and residual incremental test

hypotheses.claim: One prior paired margin/SBL vintage establishes stable revision behavior
hypotheses.support: The 2026-10-06 EARLY/LATE pair passed arithmetic and revealed an eligibility revision
hypotheses.counter: Single-date stability cannot establish cross-date stability or future availability
hypotheses.alternative: Later corrections depend on broker workflow and security state

hypotheses.claim: Displayed borrow quote and rate identify true borrow utilization
hypotheses.support: A genuine 2026-10-07 in-slot fee observation exists
hypotheses.counter: Total lendable inventory denominator unverified and displayed books are asymmetric

hypotheses.claim: Certified 1852-symbol TDCC cohort can be reused for future pairs
hypotheses.counter: Membership and corporate actions change over time
hypotheses.failure: No newer TDCC pair after 2026-10-08 certified

validationControls.PIT: Separate use-date, unit observation date, posting, capturedAt, firstKnownAt and field-level clocks; missing proof means UNKNOWN
validationControls.OOS: No outcome join before D16/00 prereg approval and full provenance
validationControls.walkForward: Chronological split; purge five-session overlapping labels
validationControls.bias: Track fund-date attrition and cache/version conflicts before inspecting outcomes
validationControls.multipleTesting: One preregistered feature/horizon; retain experiment ledger
validationControls.overfit: No post-hoc sign/threshold or fund-label permutation without exchangeability
validationControls.redundancy: Same root across ETF, institution, borrow, crowding and price-volume
validationControls.liquidity: Prior 20 completed sessions; no assumed open fill under halt/limit
validationControls.regime: At least two independently observed market states for promotion
